task: Read-only P06 runner, replay and provenance audit; identify concrete validation gaps and original-artifact qualification steps.

findings.summary: Disjoint create, advance and close durations can together exceed the complete process duration while summarize accepts them.
findings.proof: The app calls create to completion, then one or more nonoverlapping advance calls, then one or more nonoverlapping close calls. advance_ns and close_ns accumulate each scope duration. Existing max(context span, each duration) containment does not constrain their serial sum.
findings.repair: Retain the context and individual interval checks; additionally bound create duration + accumulated advance_ns + accumulated close_ns by the process receipt duration plus its existing 1000 ns rounding allowance. Do not sum nested event or stage durations into this top-level sum.

findings.summary: Individually bounded serial child timings can sum to more than their enclosing advance duration.
findings.proof: On a successful trace, advance completes submit/wait/compare/release for each stage serially; each operation is closed before the next stage. Bridge and its comparison, assembly and its comparison use separate scopes. Repeated polling adds disjoint waits to per-stage wait_ns and disjoint enclosing calls to advance_ns. Native event profiles may overlap those waits and must never be added.
findings.repair: Bound the sum of all three stages submit durations, accumulated waits, comparisons and closes plus bridge, bridge comparison, assembly and output comparison by accumulated advance_ns; preserve existing individual checks.

findings.summary: Retained replay deliberately checks internal packet consistency, not authentic repository content or GitHub origin.
findings.requirement: Independently record artifact metadata and digests from GitHub; compare every retained source body to its Git blob at the externally supplied revision, including submodule blobs through their pinned commits.
